safety.subtitle: Your safety is our priority. Learn essential tips for secure networking and safe connections.

items.privacy: You decide how much to share — switch to an avatar anytime, and we never share your phone number or exact address with other users.

items.hateful: Share hateful, violent, or discriminatory content
items.impersonation: Impersonate others or create fake sessions
items.personalData: Ask for personal data like address, phone number, or social handles
items.explicit: Send explicit, pornographic, or offensive messages
items.scamming: Engage in scamming, phishing, or money requests
items.offPlatform: Try to move chats to outside messaging apps for deceptive purposes
items.tracking: Attempt to track or locate users beyond what Bluetooth provides

prohibitedConduct.consequence: Any of these actions can result in suspension or permanent ban.

commonSense.title: Use Common Sense & Caution

items.noPersonalInfo: Don't share your full name, address, phone number, or financial info
items.cautious: Be cautious of people who quickly ask to move the chat elsewhere
items.noPressure: Don't feel pressured to respond or continue a conversation

redFlags.title: 🛑 Watch for Red Flags:

items.quickLove: Someone claims to be in love after only a few messages
items.moneyRequests: Requests to send money or personal details
items.strangeLinks: Strange links or requests for off-platform chats
items.emergencyStories: Stories involving emergency travel, hospital bills, or visa issues

redFlags.advice: If anything feels off, block and report.

safetyTips.noRides: Don't accept rides from people you just met
safetyTips.chargePhone: Charge your phone and keep it nearby
safetyTips.ownTransport: Arrange your own transportation in both directions
